summary: ExcelinEd in Action argues that the FCC should preserve the E‑Rate program, reject any education‑related conditions (screen‑time limits, parental opt‑outs, or outcome mandates), and avoid narrowing eligibility or sunsetting the program. ExcelinEd in Action opposes new education‑related conditions on the E‑Rate program, argues that the program supports a wide range of school functions beyond student device use, and urges the FCC to sustain the program and avoid unfunded mandates.
